question: What is the central funding allocated for the Special Assistance to the States for Capital Investment (SASCI) scheme?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**₹3,295.76 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• SASCI Initiative for Promotion of Lesser-Known Destinations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**SASCI scheme** launched by the **Ministry of Tourism** with ₹3,295.76 crore funding.

 
 
• 
 
**40 tourism projects** approved, focusing on **lesser-known tourist destinations**.

 
 
• 
 
**100% funding** from the central government for the approved projects.

 
 
• 
 
**State governments** handle **operation and maintenance** after project completion.

 
 
• 
 
Projects aim for **responsible tourism**, **sustainability**, and **employment generation**.

 
 
• 
 
Projects selected through a **challenge-based model** to ensure **quality**.

 
 
• 
 
Aimed at improving **local economies**, creating jobs, and involving the **private sector**.
